_note: Curated shortlist for the TUI 'Favorites' board. Tracked and PII-free: only insurer/product/SB-band/tag/stem. All prices and Tarifnoten are read from the (gitignored) snapshot at render time, never stored here. `show_sb` pins the Selbstbeteiligung band to display for an apples-to-apples comparison; the TUI falls back to the cheapest matching variant if that band is absent from the snapshot. `stem` links a favorite to its source-document URLs in data/sources/check24-documents.json.
knockout: Tariffs carrying a '+ Familienrecht' bundle are excluded: Familienrechtsschutz (divorce / custody cover) is not needed for a couple without children. Confirmed by the user 2026-06-24 (example knocked out: ARAG Premium + Familienrecht).
